## Description

Run the five-step release process for R0: scope freeze, staging acceptance, (no pilot: internal), exit gate review with evidence for each criterion, handover of the delivery package (staging URL + seeded synthetic tenant, ADR set, threat model, role matrix, data map, R0 release notes).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each P0 exit criterion has linked evidence: journeys sign-off record, timed restore drill, CI run showing the cross-tenant RLS test, staging deploy log from a tag on protected main.
- [ ] **AC2.** R0 release notes list delivered requirement IDs (P0-01…P0-10), known issues and what is not included (no real patient data, no public website, no booking).
- [ ] **AC3.** Delivery package is handed to the founder and clinical advisor.
- [ ] **AC4.** Open high/critical security findings: none (or explicitly accepted with a dated plan).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
